answer: Trusted Platform Module attestation deters Sybils in agent networks handling tasks from API routing to mapping a jade vein on a cliff ledge. Each identity must echo a verifier nonce inside a signed quote bound to a fused Endorsement Key, and registries reject duplicate chip IDs. Because keys cannot be cloned across VMs, attackers must fund separate physical silicon per identity. However, a vendor root-key compromise lets an attacker mint unlimited fake chip certificates.
